sections.heading: Type power
lines: Dark moves, dragon moves, and against targets at or below half hp water moves are 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Doom Desire, Light of Ruin, and Oblivion Wing: 2× stronger.

Ancient Power, Bitter Blade, Bitter Malice, Dazzling Gleam, Diamond Storm, Dynamax Cannon, Eternabeam, Flash Cannon, Hydro Vortex, Hyperspace Fury, Hyperspace Hole, Judgment, Luster Purge, Moonblast, Phantom Force, Roar of Time, Salt Cure, Shadow Ball, Shadow Claw, Shadow Force, Shadow Sneak, Spacial Rend, and Tera Starstorm: 1.5× stronger.
Brine, Dark Pulse, and Night Daze: 1.2× stronger.
Dark Pulse, Dark Void, Diamond Storm, and Night Daze: never miss.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Rock-type.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Purifying Salt restores 1/16 of its HP.
Soul Eater restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Magical Seed: Defense +1, Special Defense +1, Speed +1, and is afflicted by Perish Song.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
